questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. You should embrace changes because something you wanted a year ago may not suit you today.
options: A. If you embrace changes, something you wanted a year ago may not suit you today.
B. You should embrace changes although a year ago may not suit today.
C. You ought to embrace changes as something you wanted a year ago may not suit you today.
D. You should embrace changes, however, something you wanted a year ago may suit you today.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “because” = “as” → chỉ nguyên nhân, và “ought to” đồng nghĩa với “should”, vẫn đúng về nghĩa khuyên nhủ. Dịch nghĩa: Bạn nên đón nhận sự thay đổi vì những điều bạn từng mong muốn một năm trước có thể không còn phù hợp với bạn ngày hôm nay.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. As the end of the school year comes closer, you might find that you have fear of the future.
options: A. When the end of the school year comes closer, so you might find that you have fear of the future.
B. Because the end of the school year comes closer, you have fear of the future.
C. When the end of the school year comes closer, you might find that you have fear of the future.
D. Although the end of the school year comes closer, you might find that you have fear of the future.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “As” trong câu gốc mang nghĩa khi (thời điểm) → dùng “When” tương đương. Dịch nghĩa: Khi năm học kết thúc đến gần, bạn có thể cảm thấy lo lắng về tương lai.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. A job can bring you money; however, it can be significantly less thrilling than enrolling in a degree.
options: A. A job can bring you money, although it can be less thrilling than enrolling in a degree.
B. A job can bring you money, but it can be less thrilling than enrolling in a degree.
C. A job can bring you money, so it can be less thrilling than enrolling in a degree.
D. A job can bring you money, as it can be less thrilling than enrolling in a degree.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Dùng “but” để nối hai mệnh đề đối lập, đồng nghĩa với “however”. Dịch nghĩa: Một công việc có thể mang lại cho bạn tiền bạc, nhưng nó ít thú vị hơn việc theo học một chương trình đại học.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. Doing volunteer work can help you learn more about yourself, form new friendships, and build your confidence.
options: A. If you do volunteer work, you can understand yourself better, have new friendships, and confidence.
B. If you do volunteer work, you can learn more, but become far less confident.
C. Volunteer work can help you learn more about yourself, but your friendships become less important.
D. Volunteer work can help you learn more about yourself, and new friendships will make you confident.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Câu diễn đạt lại đúng nghĩa gốc, giữ được cả 3 ý: hiểu bản thân, có thêm bạn mới, và tự tin hơn. Dịch nghĩa: Làm công việc tình nguyện có thể giúp bạn hiểu rõ hơn về bản thân, và những tình bạn mới sẽ giúp bạn thêm tự tin.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. He felt very tired. However, he was determined to finish all the work deadlines.
options: A. As the result of his tiredness, he was determined to finish all the work deadlines.
B. Feeling very tired, he was determined to finish all the work deadlines.
C. Although he felt tired, he was determined to finish all the work deadlines.
D. He felt so tired that he was determined to finish all the work deadlines.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “However” thể hiện sự tương phản → dùng although để nối hai mệnh đề trái nghĩa. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù rất mệt, anh ấy vẫn quyết tâm hoàn thành mọi hạn công việc.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. I like Elon Musk. He has inspired many young people to pursue their dreams.
options: A. I like Elon Musk because he has inspired many young people to pursue their dreams.
B. I like Elon Musk, has inspired many young people to pursue their dreams.
C. I like Elon Musk and who has inspired many young people to pursue their dreams.
D. I like Elon Musk so he has inspired many young people to pursue their dreams.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Dùng because để nối hai mệnh đề chỉ nguyên nhân - kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi thích Elon Musk vì ông ấy đã truyền cảm hứng cho nhiều bạn trẻ theo đuổi ước mơ.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. The speech was very boring. Most of us felt sleepy.
options: A. The speech was very boring that most of us felt sleepy.
B. It was so a boring speech that most of us felt sleepy.
C. The speech was too boring that most of us felt sleepy.
D. The speech was so boring that most of us felt sleepy.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Dùng cấu trúc so + adj + that + clause để diễn tả mức độ dẫn đến kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Bài phát biểu quá nhàm chán nên hầu hết chúng tôi đều buồn ngủ.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence A, B, C, or D that is closest in meaning to the original sentence. Ngoc couldn’t speak English. She decided to settle in Manchester.
options: A. Despite of speaking no English, Ngoc decided to settle in Manchester.
B. Although no speaking English, Ngoc decided to settle in Manchester.
C. In spite of her disability to speak English, Ngoc decided to settle in Manchester.
D. Ngoc decided to settle in Manchester even she didn’t speak English.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc: in spite of + N / V-ing / cụm danh từ Dịch nghĩa: Dù không biết nói tiếng Anh, Ngọc vẫn quyết định định cư ở Manchester.
